title: Rabbi Horyani, Brother of Rabbi Shmuel bar Sosarti
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 9:3: his brother wanted to divide [the estate] with him; he said to him, “Alexandri, my brother, you know that our father left two thousand,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 9:3 has ידע את, “you know,” following the address “Alexandri, my brother.” The phrase is a second-person address, not a statement that Alexandri knows something.

The digital paragraph fully writes Rabbi Horyana, brother of Rabbi Shmuel bar Sosartay, and then the address “Alexandri, my brother.” These differing name forms are preserved without resolving the identities of the brothers.
